name: EX-08 Crisis Management Simulation — 3 Days
description: 3-day multi-agency crisis management simulation, working hours (0800–1800). Covers initial crisis notification, escalation, inter-agency coordination, public information management, and recovery. Demonstrates how a civilian crisis management exercise differs from military exercises: emphasis on information, legal authority, and media management.

locks.reason: Day 1 lunch break — no crisis injects
Overnight recess D1/D2 — exercise continues at 0800 Day 2
Overnight recess D2/D3 — exercise continues at 0800 Day 3

items.title: STARTEX
items.description: Exercise begins. Emergency Operations Centre (EOC) activated. All agency representatives take their seats.

items.title: INJECT: Crisis Notification
items.description: Exercise inject: notification received of a major infrastructure failure affecting power and communications across the region.

items.title: EOC Activation
items.description: Emergency Operations Centre fully activated. Agency leads confirm presence, comms tested, situation boards updated.

items.title: Initial Situation Briefing
items.description: Crisis coordinator briefs all agencies on the initial incident: scope, affected area, known impacts, initial priorities.

items.title: PIO: Initial Media Brief Preparation
items.description: Public Information Officer prepares the first public statement. Draft for approval by crisis coordinator before release.

items.title: Inter-Agency Coordination Call
items.description: Call with all represented agencies (Police, Fire, Health, Utilities, Transport). Establish responsibilities, resources, and coordination channels.

items.title: Deadline: First Public Statement
items.description: First public statement must be released by this time. Delay risks public anxiety and media pressure.

items.title: SITREP 1300 D1
items.description: Mid-day consolidated situation report. All agencies submit status to the EOC crisis coordinator.

items.title: INJECT: Escalation — Additional Area
items.description: Exercise inject: the crisis has spread to an additional district. New agency resources required. Legal authority for emergency powers activation.

items.title: Resource Allocation Decision
items.description: Crisis coordinator must allocate additional resources across the expanded affected area. Prioritization required.

items.title: Evacuation Coordination
items.description: Police and Transport agencies coordinate evacuation of affected residential zones. 2000 simulated residents.

items.title: Medical Response Coordination
items.description: Health agency coordinates medical response. Field hospitals activated. Patient tracking initiated.

items.title: Deadline: Second Public Statement
items.description: Updated public statement required with evacuation guidance.

items.title: SITREP 1600 D1
items.description: Afternoon report. Evacuation progress, medical status, utilities restoration estimate, public response.

items.title: Day 1 Operations Review
items.description: EOC close-of-day review. Assess Day 1 response effectiveness. Priorities for Day 2. Media strategy update.

items.title: D1 Close
items.description: Day 1 exercise activities concluded. Overnight recess. EOC maintains minimal watch.

items.title: D2 Morning Brief
items.description: Day 2 commences. Overnight summary. Resource status. Day 2 stabilization objectives.

items.title: Resource Status Update
items.description: All agencies report resource consumption, availability for Day 2, and gaps requiring inter-agency support.

items.title: Stabilization Operations D2
items.description: Stabilization phase. Utilities restoration, shelter coordination, return-to-home assessment for cleared areas.

items.title: External Agency Debrief
items.description: Debrief with external agencies (National Red Cross, NGOs, Media representatives). Information sharing and coordination.

items.title: SITREP D2 Afternoon
items.description: Afternoon D2 report. Stabilization progress, remaining critical tasks, Day 3 priorities.

items.title: Stabilization Decision Point
items.description: Decision: Is the situation stable enough to begin phased return and stand-down of emergency resources?

items.title: Day 2 Summary
items.description: D2 close. Confirm Day 3 recovery plan. Media statement for overnight.

items.title: D2 Close
items.description: Day 2 exercise activities concluded. Overnight recess.

items.title: D3 Morning Brief
items.description: Day 3 commences. Transition to recovery phase. Review D1/D2 performance.

items.title: Recovery Operations D3
items.description: Recovery phase. Infrastructure restoration, returning residents, service normalisation, administration.

items.title: Lessons Observed Collection
items.description: Structured lessons observed exercise. All agencies document: what was planned, what happened, gap analysis.

items.title: Final Report Compilation
items.description: Crisis coordinator compiles the final exercise report for all agency heads.

items.title: Multi-Agency AAR
items.description: Full multi-agency after action review. Structured: situation, actions, results, lessons. Actionable recommendations.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: 3-day crisis management exercise concluded. Exercise reports to be submitted within 5 working days.
